name: CCA 976 起落架问题 襟翼问题 烟雾

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 976, you are parking at gate 26, you have received information P, request ATC clearance to Beijing from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 976，停在 26 号登机口，已收到信息 P，向武汉放行请求前往 Beijing 的 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 976, gate 26, information P, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 976，26 号登机口，信息 P，请求前往 Beijing 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: CCA 976, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, Z Foxtrot01D, initial altitude 2700 meters, cruising level 8100m, after departure, contact 125.9, squawk 6563, runway in use 04.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 976，许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，执行 ZF-01D，初始高度 2700 米，巡航高度 8100m，离场后联系 125.9，应答机 6563，当前使用 Runway 04。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, ZF01 DAL departure, initial altitude 2700 meters, cruising level 8100 meter, after departure, contact 125.9, squawk 6563, Runway 04, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，执行 ZF-01 DAL 离场，初始高度 2700 米，巡航高度 8100 米，离场后联系 125.9，应答机 6563，Runway 04，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, push back approved, report ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，推出批准，准备滑行时报告。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备滑行，联系武汉地面。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, there is a disabled Boeing 737 on the taxiway A, follow the follow-me car on A9, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，滑行道 A 上有一架故障 Boeing 737，跟随 A9 上的引导车，在跑道 04 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, follow the follow-me car on A9, hold short of Runway 04, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跟随 A9 上的引导车，在跑道 04 前等待，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，在跑道 04 前等待。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 976, ready for departure.

cards.audioText: CCA 976, traffic on 11 km final, wind calm, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 976，相关航空器位于 11 km 五边，静风，许可立即从 Runway 04 起飞。
cards.referenceText: cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可立即从 Runway 04 起飞，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: B: As you apply power, you hear a master warning alarm, tell Wuhan Tower you are stopping.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 当你加推力时，听到主警告警报，告诉 武汉塔台 你正在中止。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 976, stopping due to master warning.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 976，因主警告中止起飞。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, expedite taxi and vacated at F, contact Ground when clear of runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，加快滑行并在 F 脱离，脱离跑道后联系 地面。
cards.referenceText: Expedite taxi and vacated at F, contact Ground when clear of runway, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加快滑行并在 F 脱离，脱离跑道后联系 地面，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Ground you are clear of Runway 04 at F, and that you had to abort takeoff because flap setting is incorrect.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 地面 你已在 F 脱离跑道 04，并因襟翼设置不正确不得不中止起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 976, runway vacated at F, we had to abort takeoff due to incorrect flap setting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 976，已在 F 脱离跑道，我们因襟翼设置不正确不得不中止起飞。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 976, ready for departure.

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, cancel SID, maintain runway heading to 1500 meters, track direct to ZF, Runway 04, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，取消 SID，保持跑道航向到 1500 米，直飞 ZF，跑道 04，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, maintain runway heading to 1500 meters, track direct to ZF, Runway 04, cleared for takeoff, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，保持跑道航向到 1500 米，直飞 ZF，跑道 04，可以起飞，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: after gear retraction, you have a smoke warning, tell Wuhan Departure you require immediate return for priority landing Runway 04. This is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 收起起落架后出现烟雾警告，告诉武汉离场你需要立即返场，优先在 Runway 04 落地。这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Departure, CCA 976, we have a smoke warning, request immediate return for priority landing Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，武汉离场，CCA 976，我们出现烟雾警告，请求立即返场，优先在 Runway 04 落地。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, climb to 900 meters, turn right heading 070, expect radar vector ILS Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，爬升到 900 米，右转航向 070，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 900 meters, turn right heading 070, expect radar vector ILS Runway 04, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 900 米，右转航向 070，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 04，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: B: Now the source of smoke can't be detected and is becoming unbearable, notify Wuhan Tower you hope to turn left, and make a landing on the nearest available Runway 22, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在烟源无法确定且变得难以忍受，通知 武汉塔台 你希望左转，并在最近可用跑道 22 着陆，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: Mayday MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Tower, CCA 976, the source of smoke can't be detected and is becoming unbearable, request turn left to make a landing on the nearest available Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉塔台，CCA 976，烟源无法确定且变得难以忍受，请求左转在最近可用跑道 22 着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, turn left heading 310, radar vector for a visual approach Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，左转航向 310，雷达引导目视进近跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 310, radar vector for a visual approach Runway 22, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 310，雷达引导目视进近跑道 22，CCA 976。
